### Research Notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud

#### **What the product does**
Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) is a multi-tenant, cloud-based commerce platform that enables brands to create unified, intelligent buying experiences across all channels (mobile, social, web, and store). It consists of two primary stacks: **B2C Commerce** (formerly Demandware) and **B2B/D2C Commerce** (built on the Salesforce Core platform).
*   **Source:** [Salesforce.com](https://www.salesforce.com/in/commerce/pricing/?bc=OTH) - "Commerce Cloud B2C Premium for businesses selling to consumers... choose the right commerce solution for your business needs."

#### **Public API Auth Methods**
A multi-tenant integration platform would primarily use **OAuth 2.0**.
*   **OAuth 2.0 (Account Manager):** Used for Admin and Data APIs (SCAPI/OCAPI). Requires a Client ID and Secret managed via the Salesforce B2C Account Manager.
*   **OAuth 2.0 (SLAS - Shopper Login and API Access Service):** Used for Shopper-facing APIs to manage guest and registered customer sessions.
*   **Bearer Token:** Used in the `Authorization` header after exchanging credentials for an access token.
*   **Source:** [Salesforce Developers](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYQA7Z_WJLy3GiFUHB5_iDusk-a9qBdW0MBvP_zI4lQKpop8RYRCM4wTF6w2H3XMkac2hGYmaJyQ0vmgzaXYaNnQ0K16n3dxMd-9VWTM-TZLptEd8Ys9xyxXH8pNhg7-KzAdZ5GXZLK9Wnfy4CT0XF1KCXAein74_S5jBT8pwDfNBSebtW5kwdY_D1cXp6XbWD4QmyRGCJKGq8A8wQn44=) - "The SCAPI Schema API uses an Account Manager OAuth 2.0 bearer token for authentication... you must use a client ID and client secret from Account Manager to request an access token."

#### **Developer Access & Cost**
Access to the B2C Commerce stack is highly restricted and not self-serve for independent developers.
*   **Free Tier / Trial:** There is no public, self-serve free tier or trial for B2C Commerce. While B2B Commerce can be enabled in a free Salesforce Developer Edition org, B2C requires a partner or customer relationship.
*   **Sandboxes:** B2C uses "On-Demand Sandboxes" (ODS), which are usage-based and require a paid contract or partner status.
*   **Partner/Sales:** Developers must join the Salesforce Partner Network (Link program) or be an employee of a customer to obtain credentials.
*   **Source:** [Salesforce Ben](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHJGy4XdRXC8qNxD4vcGkgpSYyxzqNLWdJv32LbQGD7V7e5zHI1VOvHV57N1GWPEayYL1QTC3PcqZnD83k4ErYTWneZpxowGBepidNt428DcVGpiG2sQYJmuQmblQJ3M_dwQagphxkVov3gYGTgx4bFVCyZHrUJMAtVW1Z4Z5L8hw==) - "B2C Commerce: The process is complex because sandboxes are not publicly available... if you work for a B2C Commerce partner company, you get access to ODS."
*   **Source:** [Rhino Inquisitor](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH8MgDs4Bnq5XZu5PfRiSjRaDEtgJnBpze1t5iCLAH5o1dMdr3A0FETfgD-SrQ7g0CU4b2snB7P5TkQI29jkL5Q8r4ORM8weRiuNJAL7AWxO4O4Ko80Fa_Q2tnNJ_WogmVmVCNRgmgr733PAJWKf_tg04f24HJApStq-wS587YSkicxdwbr9Y1LZZb7) - "To obtain a trial sandbox please reach out to either your Commerce Cloud Account Executive (customers) or your Partner Manager (partners)."

#### **API Style & Breadth**
*   **Style:** RESTful (SCAPI and OCAPI).
*   **Breadth:** Extremely broad, covering product catalogs, inventory, orders, customers, promotions, and site management.
*   **OpenAPI Spec:** Yes, Salesforce provides OpenAPI (OAS 3.0) specifications for SCAPI.
*   **Webhooks:** SFCC uses "Hooks" (custom script-based triggers) and "Event Notifications" rather than standard self-serve webhooks.
*   **Source:** [Salesforce Developers](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHV4tWTwqx7qwvWgR9YSF0nYrA7PZr_VkChhT_2M2Qxo0DFV0rnhjYdkndO6fBnzk88NlxM0nKRObJ3uBt6voFpx-dibnk2gXKFzsDjleM8u6hOePZqvdSQOHJOdu-JjxFNq4ty_AvVRrtOCyrp69R_mD8g_cgvJseLF9OrqvwUx-9J3ndamsFJpdPu0gmZLAe3kJ49jWEdcwltZ6H-vWk=) - "Converted SCAPI RAML specifications to OpenAPI Specification (OAS) format... OAS tooling aids in generating client libraries."

#### **MCP Servers**
*   **Official:** Salesforce maintains an official MCP server for B2C developer tooling.
*   **Source:** [GitHub (SalesforceCommerceCloud)](https://salesforcecommercecloud.github.io/b2c-developer-tooling/mcp/) - "B2C Commerce tools, documentation, and skills for your assistant... npx -y @salesforcecommercecloud/b2c-dx-mcp."
*   **Community:** Third-party MCP servers exist for broader Business Manager operations.
*   **Source:** [The Commerce Team](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGGZxp3XVhu3P1ldIbtG-N0sfxU9jqEif0coxr71LAveWQmziw8fsJKgv4D-SNaLiJwaCBARt5fNSqqFpQpTLQp26r4BD_J7gLVMD2LDHovVnmfaRSqwhR--nKjSV9dFwBBQtI9BbW9-JPdF7izk2VuO-t3e2E5yxXZ4Q==) - "TCTG's SFCC MCP Server turns AI from scattered experiments into a safe, shared engine."

#### **Buildability Verdict**
**Verdict:** `needs_outreach`
**Main Blocker:** There is no self-serve, free developer access to the B2C Commerce platform. A developer cannot sign up and obtain working API credentials without being a verified partner or a paying customer. While the API is well-documented and an official MCP server exists, the infrastructure is gated behind sales and enterprise contracts.
